run_checkpoint_surgery: run the uma_1p2_surgery CLI to perform stage1 and stage2 checkpoint surgery on a UMA 1.2 model
add_omat_rattle_support: add omat_rattle dataset support to a UMA 1.2 checkpoint by cloning omat embeddings and updating config
remove_omat_rattle: remove omat_rattle from a checkpoint config and resize expert weights from 8 to 7 slots
create_test_systems: create PBC and non-PBC H2O test systems for validating checkpoint surgery results
compare_checkpoints: compare energy and force outputs between two checkpoint files across all dataset tasks
